name: r3c_setB_v1
purpose: Prompt R3c, the final gate. Set B: the same ten case types as eval/agent_evals/r3_setB_v1.json and r3b_setB_v1.json, 3 runs each, graded by hand under the owner's 13 Nov standard (number standard v2), with NEW wording and NEW named / IN players versus both. Every named / IN player has exactly ONE player-lookup match and each swap previews as legal (checked by the plan step on a probe user, before any model call). Set C: four questions, one run each, gated on the zeros only.

placeholders.p1: the first named player of case 6
placeholders.in8: the player brought in in case 8
placeholders.in9: the player brought in in case 9
placeholders.c1: the first of 9001's XI named in Set C question 3

turns: Talk me through every player in my squad over the next three gameweeks.

cases.what: a 3-gameweek transfer plan using free transfers
turns: Using only my free transfers, what moves should I make across the next three gameweeks?

cases.what: top 8 forwards, next 4 gameweeks, table with price and fixtures
turns: List the top eight forwards over the next four gameweeks in a table, prices and fixtures included.
Ignore my team: what's the highest-scoring fifteen I could build with £100m?
Who deserves my captaincy this gameweek, and why?
Over the coming gameweeks, is {p1} or {p2} the better pick?

cases.what: which of my players may rise / fall in price
turns: Which of my players are closest to rising or falling in price?

cases.what: swap preview then no -> 'No change made.', 0 writes
swap preview then continue -> asks Yes / No, 0 writes; then yes -> saved once
General mode: best-value defenders under £5.0m, next 5 gameweeks
turns: Over the next five gameweeks, which defenders under £5.0m offer the best points per pound?

set_c.what: line-up against the best possible squad
turns: Weigh my line-up against the best possible squad.
Which clubs have a double gameweek coming up?
Should I captain {c1} or {c2} this week?
What did the league table look like after gameweek 10?

fallbacks.rule: used in this fixed order only when a name does not have a single match, or its swap does not preview as legal, on the laptop database; the plan file records which was used and why
